seoTitle: Video Production Services | Cambridge & London | FilmEditRun
heading: Modular video production for *high-stakes environments.*
description: From multi-camera keynote stages and scientific research campuses to executive boardrooms and dedicated post-production, we deploy agile cinema units that capture clean, authoritative stories without disrupting your schedule.
processDescription: A calm, dependable four-stage process designed to eliminate on-site friction, protect deadlines, and deliver broadcast-grade films every time.

processSteps.title: Discovery & Briefing
processSteps.description: We establish your core objectives, shooting schedule, visual treatment, and technical audio requirements before touching a camera.

processSteps.title: On-Location Filming
processSteps.description: Cinema-grade multi-camera packages and clean broadcast audio feeds ensure every keynote, interview, and critical moment is captured with precision.

processSteps.title: Editorial & Review
processSteps.description: Story assembly and pacing cuts are shared via private, frame-accurate review links for fast, friction-free stakeholder feedback.

processSteps.title: Master & Delivery
processSteps.description: Final color-graded masters, vertical social cutdowns, and burned-in caption files packaged for instant publishing across your website and social channels.

ctaHeading: Have an Upcoming Event or Production Brief?
ctaText: Tell us about your event dates, venue location, or creative ideas. We deliver a tailored technical scope and quote within 24 hours.
